title: Quick Reference Card — Outage Credit Increment Hours at Electric Service Agreement Addresses with Repeated Outages
content:
**Electric Service Agreement — sustained-outage credit increment hours where outages recur at the service address.**

The increment hours for the sustained-outage credit are one quarter of the schedule's outage credit increment hours when five or more outage records at the service address began in the 12 calendar months before the credit is posted, half of those increment hours when three or four records began in that period, and the schedule's outage credit increment hours when two or fewer began.

| Outage records at the service address that began in the 12 calendar months before the credit is posted | Increment hours for the sustained-outage credit |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | 0.25 times the schedule's outage credit increment hours |
| 3 or 4 | 0.5 times the schedule's outage credit increment hours |
| 2 or fewer | no reduction applies |

**Counting.** Every outage record at the service address that began in the period counts, the record being compensated included when it began in the period. Every count over a stated number of calendar months before a posting takes the records dated less than that many whole calendar months before the posting date: a hypothetical record that began on the boundary day, exactly 12 whole calendar months before the posting date, is not counted; one that began the day after is counted.

**Where the increment hours act.** The excess hours over the minimum duration are divided by these increment hours, and the quotient is rounded down to a whole number of full increments.

**Hypothetical check.** Schedule increment hours of 8 and excess hours of 9:

| Records in the period | Increment hours | Full increments |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 8 | 1 |
| 3 | 4 | 2 |
| 4 | 4 | 2 |
| 5 | 2 | 4 |
